gizmo.title: Ukonde wa chilengedwe
gizmo.description: Ukonde wochitirana wa momwe magawo a pulojekiti amalumikizirana, ndi maukonde ang'onoang'ono ndi maulendo a sitepe ndi sitepe.

configure.title: Deta ya ukonde
configure.description: URL ya mtolo wa JSON wa maukonde (womangidwa mu PRAW, ecosystem-webs.json).

configure.title: Ukonde
configure.description: ID ya ukonde woti uwonetsedwe koyamba; main ndi ukonde wa chilengedwe.

configure.title: Tayilo yosankhidwa
configure.description: ID ya tayilo yoti isankhidwe ukonde ukatseguka.

configure.title: Yambani mu mawonekedwe a mndandanda
configure.description: Onetsani ukonde ngati mindandanda yokhala mkati mwa ina m'malo mwa chojambula.

configure.title: Chojambula chokha
configure.description: Onetsani chojambula chokha, ngati chithunzi: palibe mutu, maulendo, zambiri kapena bala ya masitepe.

advanced.title: Werengani motsatira
advanced.description: Yambani ndi tayilo iliyonse yowerengedwa ndi muyeso umodzi.
